tool_input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/Storefront/Invoices/Money.cs'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
old='    private static readonly CultureInfo StoreCulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("de-DE");\n'
new='''    // German number format, spelled out here so it does not depend on the culture data (ICU) of the host.
    private static readonly NumberFormatInfo StoreFormat = NumberFormatInfo.ReadOnly(new NumberFormatInfo
    {
        NumberGroupSeparator = ".",
        NumberDecimalSeparator = ",",
        NumberGroupSizes = [3],
        NumberDecimalDigits = 2,
        NegativeSign = "-",
        NumberNegativePattern = 1,
    });
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new).replace('ToString("N2", StoreCulture)','ToString("N2", StoreFormat)')
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
EOF

tool_input.description: Replace host culture lookup with explicit number format, then run Money and Receipt tests normally and in invariant-globalization mode
Run Money tests in invariant-globalization mode
Run Money tests in invariant-globalization mode

result:
- **Cause:** `Money.Format` looked up the `de-DE` culture from the host. The output `1,234.50` is what .NET gives when culture data is missing, so runner-05 is most likely running in invariant-globalization mode (no ICU). This is inferred from the output; I couldn't inspect the runner. Nothing in the repo or `.gitlab-ci.yml` sets that mode, and the MR's commit didn't touch `Format`.
- **Action:** Changed `src/Storefront/Invoices/Money.cs` to use an explicit German `NumberFormatInfo` (dot for thousands, comma for decimals) instead of `CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("de-DE")`. The test is unchanged.

The Money and Receipt tests pass locally (6/6). I could not reproduce the invariant-mode run locally because that command was denied, so the fix is unconfirmed against the runner's condition.

The change is not committed or pushed, so the pipeline won't go green until you do that.

The runner still differs from the others. Any other code that relies on culture data will behave differently on runner-05, so its setup is worth a look.
